"""Freeze and observe the authorized 12-task development suite with current zero States."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import signal

from rwkv_lh.runtime.settings import load_local_env, reset_runtime_settings
from rwkv_lh.exact_tool_selector.native_network_client import NativeNetworkSelectorSettings
from scripts import run_rwkv_e2e_benchmark as benchmark

root = Path('/home/chase/GitHub/RWKV-LH')
round_dir = root / 'data/experiments/CURRENT_ROLE_CHAIN_OBSERVATION_R3_20260909'
round_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
load_local_env()
model = 'rwkv7-g1j-13.3b-zero-state-capability-ctx16384'
common = {'BASE_URL': 'http://127.0.0.1:29613/v1', 'MODEL': model,
    'MODEL_SHA256': '559371f5b9aef13189ae54b345ac096af4ad2b689996c05d89de687612b3ae65',
    'BACKEND_PROFILE': 'vllm-rwkv-native', 'STATE_PROFILE_ID': 'zero', 'STATE_PROFILE_SHA256': '0'*64,
    'STATE_PROFILE_DELIVERY': 'request', 'STATE_TRANSPORT': 'native_required', 'RETURN_TOKEN_IDS': 'true',
    'MAX_MODEL_LEN': '16384', 'TOOL_DISCLOSURE_MODE': 'progressive', 'READ_TIMEOUT': '900',
    'API_KEY': '', 'CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID': '', 'CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET': '', 'PROXY_URL': '', 'TRUST_ENV': 'false'}
for role in ('EXECUTOR','AUDITOR_STEP','FINALIZER','AUDITOR_FINAL'):
    for suffix, value in common.items(): os.environ[f'RWKV_LH_{role}_{suffix}'] = value
for suffix, value in common.items(): os.environ[f'RWKV_{suffix}'] = value
planner = {'BASE_URL':'http://127.0.0.1:29613/v1','MODEL':model,'API_KEY':'local-no-auth',
    'BACKEND_PROFILE':'vllm-rwkv-native','MAX_PLAN_TOKENS':'8192','MAX_CONTRACT_REVIEW_TOKENS':'2400',
    'READ_TIMEOUT':'900','PLAN_CACHE_ENABLED':'false','FALLBACK_MODELS':'','SERIALIZE_REQUESTS':'false'}
for prefix in ('RWKV_LH_PLANNER_', 'SUPERVISOR_'):
    for suffix, value in planner.items(): os.environ[prefix+suffix] = value
os.environ['RWKV_LH_STAGE_CHECKER_MODEL'] = model
os.environ['RWKV_RUNTIME_MODE'] = 'external'
os.environ['RWKV_EXECUTOR_PROFILE_ROUTING'] = 'disabled'
reset_runtime_settings()
settings = benchmark.get_runtime_settings()
roles = benchmark._goal_role_settings(settings)
selector = NativeNetworkSelectorSettings.from_env()
assert selector is not None and selector.state_profile_id == 'zero'
assert all(s.state_profile_id == 'zero' and s.state_profile_sha256 == '0'*64 for s in roles.values())
source = benchmark._source_tree_manifest(root)
task_path = root / 'benchmarks/rwkv_e2e/rwkv_real_project_dev_v1/tasks.json'
task_data = json.loads(task_path.read_text())
tasks = task_data['tasks']
assert len(tasks) == 12
command = [str(root / '.venv/bin/python'), str(root / 'scripts/run_rwkv_e2e_benchmark.py'),
    '--suite','realprojectdevv1','--supervisor','openai','--supervisor-strategy','goal_stages',
    '--stateful-goal','--independent-selector','--max-transitions','200','--tool-disclosure-mode','progressive',
    '--concurrency','3','--supervisor-pending-resume-attempts','0',
    '--supervisor-batch-failure-policy','continue_model_failures','--output',str(round_dir / 'all_zero')]
registration = {'round_id':round_dir.name,'created_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    'purpose':'current production chain observation and Selector trace audit; no training',
    'source_kind':'owner-authorized authored development benchmark; actual production Harness traces',
    'code_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=root,text=True).strip(),
    'source_files':source,'driver_sha256':hashlib.sha256(Path(__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'visible_tasks_sha256':hashlib.sha256(task_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    'task_ids':[t['task_id'] for t in tasks],'command':command,'max_wall_seconds':3600,'budget_termination':'entire runner and worker process group',
    'case_concurrency':3,'supervisor_serialize_requests':False,'max_transitions_per_case':200,'optimizer_steps':0,'fixed_public_plan':False,
    'role_runtimes':benchmark._goal_role_runtime_identities(roles),'selector_identity':selector.runtime_identity(),
    'planner':{k:v for k,v in planner.items() if k!='API_KEY'},
    'metrics':['Strict count / 12','completed count / 12','mutation action count',
               'termination reason for every case','tool actions','role boundary counts','Selector auditable candidates'],
    'policy':'retain every failure and original score; no per-case reruns, hidden-label exposure, threshold changes or source changes; registered transport retries remain 2 and HTTP-200 protocol errors are terminal',
    'role_data':{'target_role':'selector_intent','other_roles_required':False,
        'candidate_scope':'existing default production-trace coverage, no post-run scope narrowing',
        'formal_dataset_creation':False,'confirmation_read':False}}
(round_dir / 'REGISTRATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(registration,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
started = time.monotonic()
with (round_dir / 'run.log').open('w') as output:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command,cwd=root,env=os.environ.copy(),stdout=output,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
    try:
        exit_code, error = process.wait(timeout=3600), None
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
        try:
            process.wait(timeout=10)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(process.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
            process.wait(timeout=10)
        exit_code, error = process.returncode, 'preregistered_wall_budget_exhausted'
finished_source = benchmark._source_tree_manifest(root)
completion = {'exit_code':exit_code,'error':error,'wall_seconds':time.monotonic()-started,
    'source_unchanged':source==finished_source,'optimizer_steps':0,
    'registration_sha256':hashlib.sha256((round_dir/'REGISTRATION.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
(round_dir / 'COMPLETION.json').write_text(json.dumps(completion,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(completion),flush=True)

"""Summarize all new production cases and audit only reached Selector boundaries."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json

from rwkv_lh.goal_state_protocols.role_trace_dataset_v1 import (
    register_case, extract_registration, SOURCE_REGISTRATION_SCHEMA,
)
from rwkv_lh.role_trace_artifacts import REQUIRED_COVERAGE

root = Path('/home/chase/GitHub/RWKV-LH')
round_dir = root / 'data/experiments/CURRENT_ROLE_CHAIN_OBSERVATION_R3_20260909'
registration = json.loads((round_dir / 'REGISTRATION.json').read_text())
output = round_dir / 'all_zero'
results = json.loads((output / 'results.json').read_text())['results']
rows, sources, rejected = [], [], []
mutating = {'write_file','write_json','patch_file','append_file','mkdir','delete_file','copy_file','move_file','edit_file'}
for result in results:
    task = result['task_id']
    case = output / 'cases' / task
    model_trace = json.loads((case/'model_trace.json').read_text()) if (case/'model_trace.json').is_file() else []
    event_log = json.loads((case/'event_log.json').read_text()) if (case/'event_log.json').is_file() else []
    counts = Counter(str(e.get('type')) for e in event_log)
    terminal = next((e for e in reversed(event_log) if e.get('type') in {
        'run_yielded', 'run_failed', 'run_completed', 'run_blocked', 'run_interrupted', 'run_suspended',
    }), None)
    reason = ((terminal.get('data') or {}).get('reason') or
              ('completed' if terminal.get('type') == 'run_completed' else None)) if terminal else None
    actions = []
    # Read the final durable snapshot, without inspecting private acceptance or reference files.
    import sqlite3
    db = case/'state/long_horizon.db'
    if db.is_file():
        from rwkv_lh.store import LongHorizonStore
        from rwkv_lh.schema import RunState
        with sqlite3.connect(db.resolve().as_uri()+'?mode=ro',uri=True) as conn:
            state_row = conn.execute('select state_json from runs where run_id=?',(task,)).fetchone()
        if state_row:
            state = RunState.from_dict(LongHorizonStore._deserialize(state_row[0]))
            actions = list(state.actions.values())
    role_counts = Counter()
    for event in model_trace:
        if event.get('type') == 'model_session_generation_returned':
            role_counts[str(event.get('model_role') or event.get('role') or 'unattributed')] += 1
    row = {'task_id':task,'strict':bool(result['passed']),'completed':bool(result['agent_completed']),
        'status':result['status'],'termination_reason':reason,'failure':result.get('failure'),'supervisor_failure':result.get('supervisor_failure'),
        'action_count':result.get('action_count',0),'actions_by_operation':dict(Counter(a.action_type for a in actions)),
        'mutation_actions':(None if any(a.status.value=='succeeded' and (not a.workspace_digest_before or not a.workspace_digest_after) for a in actions) else sum(a.status.value=='succeeded' and a.workspace_digest_before!=a.workspace_digest_after for a in actions)),
        'model_responses_by_role':dict(role_counts),'event_counts':dict(counts),
        'supervisor_requests':result.get('supervisor_request_count',0)}
    rows.append(row)
    try:
        value = register_case(case,run_id=task,source_run_id=output.name,
            project_family=f'realprojectdevv1:{task}',suite='realprojectdevv1')
        sources.extend(value['source_runs'])
    except Exception as exc:
        rejected.append({'task_id':task,'error_type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)})
summary = {'round_id':round_dir.name,'registered_tasks':registration['task_ids'],
    'observed_tasks':[row['task_id'] for row in rows],'all_cases_recorded':[row['task_id'] for row in rows]==registration['task_ids'],
    'agent':{'strict':sum(row['strict'] for row in rows),'completed':sum(row['completed'] for row in rows),'denominator':12,
        'mutation_actions':(None if any(row['mutation_actions'] is None for row in rows) else sum(row['mutation_actions'] for row in rows)),'actions':sum(row['action_count'] for row in rows),
        'termination':dict(Counter(row['termination_reason'] or 'unknown' for row in rows))},'cases':rows,
    'selector_source_admission':{'accepted':len(sources),'rejected':rejected},'optimizer_steps':0}
if sources:
    source_registration=round_dir/'SELECTOR_SOURCE_REGISTRATION.json'
    source_registration.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':SOURCE_REGISTRATION_SCHEMA,'source_runs':sources},indent=2)+'\n')
    try:
        audit = extract_registration(source_registration,round_dir/'selector_candidates',roles=['selector_intent'])
        # Do not open generated dev/confirmation sample payloads; this is a coverage/provenance audit only.
        summary['selector_audit_manifest']=audit
    except Exception as exc:
        summary['selector_audit_error']={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc)}
(round_dir/'OBSERVATION.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(summary['agent'],ensure_ascii=False))

"""Diagnose recorded Supervisor outputs, without changing or rescoring a run."""
from pathlib import Path
from collections import Counter
import hashlib
import json
import re
ROOT = Path('/home/chase/GitHub/RWKV-LH')
ROUND = ROOT / 'data/experiments/CURRENT_ROLE_CHAIN_OBSERVATION_R3_20260909'
rows = []
for case in sorted((ROUND / 'all_zero/cases').iterdir()):
    path = case / 'audit.json'
    if not path.is_file():
        continue
    trace = json.loads(path.read_text()).get('supervisor_trace', [])
    starts = {e['call_id']: e for e in trace if e['type'] == 'supervisor_request_started'}
    for event in trace:
        if event['type'] != 'supervisor_raw_response_returned':
            continue
        raw = event.get('raw_output', '')
        start = starts[event['call_id']]
        item = {'task_id': case.name, 'call_id': event['call_id'], 'finish_reason': event.get('finish_reason'),
            'usage': event.get('usage'), 'raw_sha256': hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest(),
            'raw_chars': len(raw), 'prompt_chars': start.get('prompt_chars'), 'input_chars': start.get('input_chars'),
            'registered_max_tokens': start.get('max_tokens'), 'sampling': start.get('sampling'),
            'head': raw[:750], 'tail': raw[-750:], 'first_json_complete': False}
        body = raw[1:].lstrip() if raw.startswith('>') else raw
        try:
            value, end = json.JSONDecoder().raw_decode(body)
            item.update(first_json_complete=True, first_json_chars=end, chars_after_first_json=len(body[end:].strip()),
                first_json_top_keys=list(value) if isinstance(value, dict) else None,
                obligation_count=len(value.get('goal_obligations', [])) if isinstance(value, dict) else None)
        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
            item['json_error'] = {'message': exc.msg, 'position': exc.pos, 'total_chars': len(body)}
        obligations = re.findall(r'"obligation_id"\s*:\s*"([^"]+)"', raw)
        predicates = re.findall(r'"predicate"\s*:\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*)"', raw)
        item.update(obligation_declarations=len(obligations), last_obligation_ids=obligations[-5:],
                    first_predicates=predicates[:5], last_predicates=predicates[-5:])
        rows.append(item)
report = {'purpose': 'wire/stop diagnosis only; no rescore or modified runtime', 'cases_with_recorded_outputs': len({r['task_id'] for r in rows}),
          'calls': len(rows), 'finish_reasons': dict(Counter(r['finish_reason'] for r in rows)),
          'first_json_complete': sum(r['first_json_complete'] for r in rows), 'rows': rows}
(ROUND / 'PLANNER_OUTPUT_DIAGNOSIS.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in report.items() if key != 'rows'}, ensure_ascii=False))
for row in rows:
    print(json.dumps(row, ensure_ascii=False))
